risk_note: RV2 (funds). adminCreateUnionReceipt, adminReverseUnionReceipt and adminListUnionReceipts are implemented. settlement writes the record, its UNION_RECEIPT voucher (debit the cash subject, credit UNION_RECEIVABLE:{platform}, the amount that arrived) and the audit record in one transaction under platform idempotency. No user balance moves and W does not change; the amount is not compared with the receivable and no difference is opened (BR-FUND-20). A reversal locks the record and judges reversed_at under that lock before ledger.reverse, because a replayed ledger.reverse returns the stored voucher without an error; two racing reversals give one voucher and one 20902. The voucher's accounting day is the Clock's, so an older collection lowers the exposure from the day it is entered and no earlier snapshot changes (D10-589 ②). The CASH_BANK criterion is payout.channel_enabled.bank_card, default off (D10-538 ⑥). The route schema runs before the guard inside the handler, as on every admin route, so an invalid body gets 20001 before 10403 / 10003; nothing is written and no data is shown (D10-591, following D10-590 ⑥). Not in this task: R1_RECON writes (D10-538 ③), adminGetFundLedger (B2-04zs), and the console page, recorded as F1-08gb. The two BR-FUND-20 defaults are still pending the finance confirmation.

S1 按编排 D10-591（沿用 D10-590 ⑥）关闭，未改代码; the contract text follows in a text-only CT. This entry records the ruling's outcome, not a Codex pass; no round 2 was run, as the ruling said, because the code did not change. Checklist otherwise ok (rounding, sign, idempotency, concurrency, clock, app_id; partial_refund na). Static, nothing executed by Codex. couli-runs/B2-04zr/money-review-r1.json.
